# PJ4 release gating

Ordinary localization pushes and PRs run only source/translation/branch checks. Native builds require the manual interface; first creation of `zh-CN-4.x-ci/manual-build-<unique-request>` is an explicit native build request. Package creation remains a separate explicit candidate ref or workflow dispatch, never a sync side effect. Inherited upstream build recipes are manual-only; inherited binary publishers additionally retain original upstream-owner scope.

The existing version/run/attempt-specific `publish-accepted-*` first-creation interface still requires accepted stable source, original successful candidate artifacts, matching hashes and final human screenshot review. The publisher verifies actual uploaded names and hashes, downloads the draft assets, and checks those original bytes before making the draft public. Its offline shell-sequence regression runs in lightweight source checks. No ordinary sync creates promotion refs. Historical refs/tags/assets remain immutable.

The GitHub default remains independent PJ3. Automatic PJ4 builds/publishing are not falsely advertised as ready: a new formal 4.x release alone does not provide a reviewed immutable PJ4 build recipe, a new downstream version mapping, or final human package acceptance. The existing 4.0.0 release is baseline, not replayed; 3.999.x beta releases are not a Qt5 or stable-PJ4 gate. Current authorized native runs are not cancelled.
